title: Practice 5: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Эта земля покрыта зелёным ковром из ___ (пышный) растительности.
exercises.prompt: This land is covered by a verdant carpet of lush vegetation.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.prompt: Tom wakes from a deep sleep.
